mechanism_claims.claim_text: FBP inhibits influenza virus entry primarily by targeting viral particles/HA and blocking low-pH HA-mediated fusion rather than by pretreating host cells or post-entry release.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FBP against influenza A(H1N1), H5N1 pseudovirus, H7N7 HA-mediated fusion context, and FluB fusion context

FBP binding to HA and absence of HAI activity

mechanism_claims.limitations: The local source supports entry/fusion interference; it does not prove virion disruption, and supplement Fig. S3 explicitly supports intact H1N1 particles after FBP exposure.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FBP inhibits endosomal acidification in MDCK and Vero-E6 cells, aligning its antiviral activity with pH-dependent entry/fusion inhibition.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FBP in MDCK and Vero-E6 cell endosomal-acidification assays

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FBP inhibits SARS-CoV-2 entry/fusion in Vero-E6/293T-ACE2 contexts through spike binding plus endosomal pathway inhibition; U5 binding to spike alone is weaker and does not reproduce the full FBP antiviral effect.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FBP against SARS-CoV-2 HKU001a, B.1.1.63/D614G, Delta, and spike-mediated fusion models
